class_name: 対比-般-ノニタイシテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Sets two facts side by side purely to contrast them (兄は口数が多いのに対して、弟はほとんど話さない), without the surprise or grievance のに carries. Bare 〜に対して after a noun is a different pattern, marking the target of an action or attitude (客に対して失礼だ). A na-adjective needs な and a noun takes なの or, in written style, であるの; the pattern is far more common in writing and reports than in casual speech.

examples.ruby: 兄[あに]は口数[くちかず]が多[おお]いのに対[たい]して、弟[おとうと]はほとんど話[はな]さない。
examples.english: The older brother is talkative, whereas the younger one hardly speaks.

examples.ruby: 昨年[さくねん]の売[う]り上[あ]げが伸[の]びたのに対[たい]し、今年[ことし]は横[よこ]ばいだ。
examples.english: Sales grew last year, while this year they have flattened out.

examples.ruby: 都心[としん]の人口[じんこう]が増[ふ]えるのに対[たい]して、地方[ちほう]は減[へ]り続[つづ]けている。
examples.english: The population of the city center is rising, whereas the regions keep losing people.
